comment: Independent external review (VR-006). Reviewer's normalization rules and the classification of keys that VR-005 lacked. Each rule is a reading of Victor Rielly's Lean source and lane documents and is open to correction.

hD.hK: Fintype.card K = gP^2; true of the quadratic extension of Goldilocks
hD.r0: define schedule r0: round-by-round soundness follows from the degree (PROVED); the stage define polynomials' degrees are ARGUED
hD.lu: LogUp schedule: the count condition is PROVED at the app's profile; IN-C's LogUp round-by-round bound is LEFT (finding L53-2)

hD: side condition of the kinds data
RunTrKinds.lean:495-508; L57 doc line 81 (stgSlotV_cut, stgDefSqV_cut, stgLkSqV_cut)
cut readers, slot degrees and windows, mask and opening counts; VR-005 classified the parent hD as open because of the fields now listed separately

inst: a proposition-valued type-class argument; true of any inhabited coin type
place: Lean inventory index 16: Fin dR → Fin Rr
the tool listed Fin's own bound proof (isLt); it is carried by the value and asks nothing
Xx: the tool listed Finset's own nodup proof; it asks nothing. On the L52 line Xx is fixed (ebXxW)
site: refusal sites of the honest run; each site carries its own bounds k and δ, so the fields can always be met; the burden is in O.refuse and O.counts
T: PROVED on the L52 line, conditionally
